summary_en: Omron Healthcare tender offer for Matsuya R&D completed 2026-06-15. 17,567,455 shares tendered (81.3% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). Offer acceptance threshold minimum 11,230,300 shares exceeded. Settlement 2026-06-19. Omron Healthcare becomes majority shareholder and parent company; Omron Corp becomes indirect parent. Prior shareholders Michihiro Goto and Masahiro Goto tender all holdings, cease to be principal shareholders.
title_en: Announcement of Results of Public Tender Offer by Omron Healthcare Co., Ltd. for Matsuya R&D Co., Ltd. Stock and Stock Acquisition Rights, and Notification of Changes to Parent Company and Principal Shareholders
translation_en_brief: Omron Healthcare Co., Ltd. completed a public tender offer for Matsuya R&D Co., Ltd. (TSE Growth 7317) on 2026-06-15. The offer ran from 2026-05-19 and targeted the company's common shares and stock acquisition rights. A total of 17,567,455 shares (including warrant-equivalent shares) were tendered, exceeding the minimum acceptance threshold of 11,230,300 shares. Settlement commences 2026-06-19. Following settlement, Omron Healthcare will own a majority stake (81.3% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) and become the principal shareholder and parent company of Matsuya R&D. Omron Corp., the parent of Omron Healthcare, will become an indirect parent of Matsuya R&D. Prior principal shareholders Michihiro Goto and Masahiro Goto tendered all their shareholdings and will cease to hold principal-shareholder status. The disclosure provides details of the tenderer and prior shareholders but does not disclose the tender price or aggregate yen value of the acquisition.
